title: Decide and enforce the late cutoff for continuity claims
description: DESIGN Flag day step 4: continuity claims against C are accepted until the late cutoff; after it people register as newcomers. No tool enforces this (found in vouch-omzm.2 review). Blocked on the owner's QUESTION in vouch-omzm notes: where to enforce (verify-continuity --cutoff from registry git history, drafts --as, or policy only) and which date counts.
notes: DATE (Mark 2026-10-23): late cutoff = flag day + 6 months. Policy only (anchors may extend by announcement). The legacy-keyring warning in the patatt fork and DESIGN/flag-day.md should state 'six months after flag day'.
close_reason: Decided: policy only (option c), migratedFrom/.asc merge rule, merge date counts
